text:
Priya A: Quick heads-up — Harvest (healthtech) wants a week-long POC. They plan to evaluate our model catalog for a question-answering + retrieval flow. Core asks: private VPC + KMS, p95 latency <200ms, target cost <= $0.70 / 1k tokens, ~100k tokens/day initially. Can we scope model variants and ops blockers?

Jonas S: For retrieval + QA I'd suggest testing two variants: llama-13b-qlora (higher quality) and llama-13b-q4_0 (latency/cost optimized). If they need p95 <200ms we'll likely need dedicated A100s with prefix KV caching.

Divya R: Tokenizer note — Harvest uses a custom vocabulary mapping from their clinical data pipeline. We need a sample corpus to run a tokenization diff and check for off-by-one tokenization that blows up prefix cache. Can AE get a small dump?

Priya A: I can request a 10k utterance sample. Also they're asking about embeddings consistency across variants — they want stable vectors for rerankers.

Divya R: Embeddings: use our standard 1536-d embed model for retrieval (stable). For embedding drift between model variants we should run 1k pairwise cosine checks pre-POC. I'll prepare a notebook.

Leah P: Ops concerns: Private/VPC + KMS is doable but needs an IR (infra request) for Customer VPC peering and a dedicated pool for the POC to hit latency SLOs. Dedicated pool estimate: 1 x a100-40g for q4_0 baseline, 2 x a100 if they run heavy batch evals. Lead time ~3 business days once legal signs. Pricing uplift for reserved POC capacity ~20% on top of hosted rates.

Priya A: Understood. Can someone give a rough cost estimate we can quote now? They want to include numeric numbers in their procurement doc.

Jonas S: Rough hosted baseline: q4_0 ~ $0.18 / 1k tokens (generation) on shared; qlora ~ $0.45 / 1k tokens. With dedicated reserved POC (+20%) and KV caching saving ~30% tokens, net effective could be ~ $0.20 - $0.40 / 1k depending on mix. Hm — target $0.70 / 1k is generous, so we're fine there.

Priya A: Great — I will push those numbers but mark as estimated. Also they asked about SLA and audit artifacts (SOC2 + penetration test).

security-bot: Please attach SOC2 type II report & latest pen test. For KMS in Private: we support AWS KMS CMKs and bring-your-own key in HSM. Key rotation: customer-managed rotation is supported; we log key usage in CloudTrail (or equivalent). Need to confirm if Harvest requires FIPS/HSM-only.

Leah P: Legal items: if they require HSM-backed keys + on-prem audit, that pushes this toward our Private on-prem package (enterprise), pricing and lead times longer. For VPC + AWS-KMS CMK in customer account, it's standard.

Priya A: Action items: (1) I will get token sample & security questionnaire answers, (2) Divya will run tokenizer + embed drift checks, (3) Leah to open infra request for dedicated pool & VPC peering, (4) Jonas to draft POC runbook + cost estimates. Can we share a config suggestion to speed approval?

Divya R: Draft config below — we'll iterate after tokenizer sample.

```yaml
model_variant: llama-13b-q4_0
fallback_variant: llama-13b-qlora
instance_profile: a100-40g-dedicated
kv_cache: enabled
cache_policy: prefix
max_sequence_length: 2048
quant_profile: q4_0
batching: auto
vpc_peering: true
kms: aws-kms-cmk (customer)
monitoring: console + token-level traces
slo_targets:
  p95_latency_ms: 200
  availability_pct: 99.9
```

Jonas S: That looks good. Suggest adding a canary route to fallback to hosted small-capacity shard if dedicated pool saturates. Also include per-route tracing and token-level cost tagging in the runbook.

Leah P: Infra ticket created: SALES-5789 (POC dedicated pool + VPC). ETA: provisioning window 72 hrs post-approval.

deploy-bot: Created ticket SALES-5789 and linked repo infra/poc-harvest.

Priya A: Thanks all. I'll book a 30-min kickoff with Harvest for tomorrow 10am PST to confirm requirements and ask for the token sample + security Q. @Divya R @Leah P please join.

Divya R: I'll bring the tokenization checklist.

Leah P: I'll bring the infra/lead-time slide.

Jonas S: Will prep a short cost/variant matrix.

Priya A: :thumbsup: Closing this thread once kickoff is done.
